title: Fixed Chair and Rear-Step Kick Sled
description: One original complete static chair-and-rear-step kick-sled appearance. Two long thin closed runners with rising front noses carry a raised four-board seat, a tall two-slat back, rearward sloping full-height posts and a wide fixed push bar. Long runner extensions behind the chair have two distinct raised step pads; cross ties and diagonal stays visibly join the frame. This whole elevated chair/push-bar/rear-step layout differs from a low plank cargo sled or a wheeled handcart. All geometry newly authored, no old sled or chair mesh imported. Static art only: no rider, propulsion, steering, sliding, stability, safe seating/standing, load capacity, manufacturing, sport or transport safety claim.
